title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Music Hall on 1973-11-30

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of a blistering late‑'73 show highlighted by a scorching Playin', Weather Report/Eyes saga and stellar Garcia work.
ai_review.review: The recording is a well‑mixed SBD that lets every instrument shine, though a few pitch‑fluctuations are noted. Musically the concert is a quintessential ’73 performance – Garcia on fire, a monster Playin', a soaring Weather Report Suite into Eyes, and standout renditions of They Love Each Other and Here Comes Sunshine.

ai_rating.rationale: 13 detailed reviews average ~4.6 stars; overwhelming praise for the performance and generally positive remarks on the soundboard quality, with only minor recording quirks.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear instrument separation and vocal clarity praised; some reviewers mention slight pitch errors that require minor correction but overall the mix is solid and well balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set delivers classic fall/winter ’73 fun with a strong Morning Dew opener; the second set builds around the Weather Report/Eyes centerpiece and a soaring Playin', creating an exhilarating arc that many reviewers call the highlight of the run.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is described as ‘on fire’, delivering blistering tone, masterful chord work and a swervy yet tight Playin'.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass on El Paso is praised (‘Phil pwns it’) and his overall groove noted positively.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob’s rhythm guitar and vocals are called solid; one reviewer notes his voice ‘shredded’ later but still effective.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith (keyboard) gets high marks for nailing the Weather Report suite and other sections, with no mention of Brent or Vince.
